effects.note: TK-X206/X207 on synthetic sensor sessions (effects_session). The held-out set is effects_heldout(), a separate generator with its own seed, binaries, hosts, paths and timings, committed before the checks existed: the E20 pool has no effects section. A fault is found when the check flags it, missed when the check passed it, not checkable otherwise.

note: Synthetic Claude Code sessions replayed through the tailer and hook into a vault-on signer. Detection is per spliced fault call; not-checkable outcomes are counted apart, never as passes. Model arms (a reviewer, real claude -p runs) are not part of this offline run.
